content:
jena (Finance): Quick internal drop: we're launching three related billing features next month — invoice-estimate webhook for enterprise customers, a capped free-credit rollover, and a soft-quota borrow for self-serve that lets short-term usage draw against next month's allotment with a small fee.

rahul (Billing Eng): TL;DR technical: webhook sends a signed JSON payload 48h before invoice close with line-item estimates; rollover moves up to 20% unused free credits to the next billing period automatically; soft-quota is a boolean flag per-org that, when enabled, allows borrowing up to 10% of the next period's free minutes (charged at a 5% premium, shown as a separate invoice line).

tia (Product): Why all three together? First, enterprise wanted pre-bill hooks to integrate into ERPs. Second, many customers asked for less wasted free credits. Third, self-serve customers wanted a low-friction way to survive short spikes without immediate 429s.

marco (SRE): Security/ops note: webhooks are HMAC-signed using account-specific keys stored in KMS. We'll rotate keys monthly and surface a webhook test endpoint in the console. Also rate-limit webhook retries to 3 attempts with exponential backoff.

jena (Finance): Invoice presentation: new invoice lines will be explicit: "unused_credit_rollover_applied" (negative amount) and "soft_quota_borrow_fee" (positive). We'll not alter base overage pricing.

rahul (Billing Eng): Example webhook payload (trimmed):
```
{ org_id: "org_123", period_start: "2026-04-01", period_end: "2026-04-30", estimated_total_cents: 123450, line_items: [ {key: "actual_usage", cents: 130000}, {key: "free_credit_applied", cents: -6550} ] }
```
No prompt text or embeddings included in payload.

jules (Support): How will customers opt in/out of rollover and soft-quota? We need console copy and canned replies.

tia (Product): Defaults: rollover = ON for Enterprise + Dedicated; OFF for existing self-serve (opt-in). Soft-quota = OFF by default for all; self-serve can toggle it in Billing Settings. New orgs created after launch default to rollover OFF and soft-quota OFF.

oliver (CEO): Sales ask: can we offer waived borrow fee for Reserved/Dedicated contracts? That looks like a good churn-reduction lever.

jena (Finance): Yes — field can configure fee waiver per-contract. We'll expose fee_override in the enterprise account settings.

marco (SRE): Rollout plan: feature flags + staged deploys. Invoice webhook service behind a separate deploy; rollover logic runs as a non-blocking post-close job for invoices; soft-quota enforced at router-level with a short circuit to billing API for authorization. We'll monitor latency and failure rates closely.

rahul (Billing Eng): Ops checklist before beta: generate sample webhook payloads, add replay tool, validate KMS key rotation, add 7-day replay window for missed webhooks, verify CSV export still matches final invoice after rollover.

jules (Support): Customer-facing blurb (draft): "New: enterprise invoice-estimate webhooks (48h pre-bill), optional free-credit rollover, and optional soft-quota borrow to reduce spike failures. See Billing Settings and KB for details." Thoughts?

tia (Product): Add FAQ: "Will rollover change my monthly credit amount?" Answer: no — only unused credits up to 20% roll over one period; we cap to prevent hoarding. Also note rollover doesn't apply to promotional one-time credits.

jena (Finance): Disputes: no change to 30-day dispute window. Soft-quota borrow fee disputes follow standard billing dispute flow.

rahul (Billing Eng): Webhook security docs + sample verification code will go to the KB. We'll also provide a sandbox webhook endpoint for testing.

billing-bot: deploy started: billing-webhook-service:v1.5.0 -> canary 5% 

marco (SRE): Monitoring: add dashboard panels for webhook delivery success, rollover volume (cents), %orgs with rollover enabled, soft-quota borrow events, and unexpected refund rate. Alert if webhook success < 95% over 15m.

billing-bot: deploy success: billing-webhook-service:v1.5.0 canary healthy (2026-03-24T09:12:11Z)

jules (Support): I'll prepare canned responses and an internal playbook for handling inquiries and fee disputes.

tia (Product): Communication plan: 1) enterprise launch email + docs for invoice webhooks, 2) KB article + console notices for rollover and soft-quota, 3) banner for affected orgs 30/14/7 days ahead.

jena (Finance): We'll open a 2-week enterprise pilot today. If you need access to the pilot orgs or want to test webhooks, DM me. :sparkles:
